topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just heard the craziest thing, and I can't stop thinking about it. Our building – you know, the one with all the walls that have been creaking and complaining with us for years – it's turning into condos. Can you even believe that? People are already talking about it in the hallways, whispering like it's some big secret. What does that mean for us, for everyone who’s been here through thick and thin? The idea of it all just swirled in my head, and I had to reach out. We need to figure this out, talk about what it means, and maybe find a way to keep our home the way it is. What do you think?
